entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: Whoa, whoa, whoa—you mean you got[n]scouted by that college!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Pipe down, stupid!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's not for sure or nothin' yet, anyway.[n]I'm just sayin' the school's gotten word[n]of something like that.

entries.speaker: Takeishi
entries.en: Still, that rules! You even made it onto[n]the podium at nationals too!

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: I was worried about what would happen[n]after you screwed up your knee, but[n]I'm glad you were able to bounce back.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Aw, you're still jumping the gun with this.[n]I'm just trying my best so I don't get[n]laughed off the team by you guys.
Ryuji is laughing happily[n]with the other members[n]of the track team...
It seems this reality is the[n]one that Ryuji wished for...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: [fName]? What're you doin' here?[n]It's still winter break.

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: Oh, maybe he stopped by to[n]congratulate you too?

entries.speaker: Takeishi
entries.en: Man, someone sure is popular.

entries.speaker: Takeishi
entries.en: Is there anywhere you wanna go eat[n]after practice? It's our treat today!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ooh! That's nice of you guys—how about[n]an extra large beef bowl and some pork[n]miso soup?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, why don't you come with us,[n][fName]?
Happy you can run now?
Enjoying the return to track?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Huh? Yeah, of course, but...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What's up all of a sudden?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, yeah it's fun, but whaddya mean?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's just what I like doin', y'know?[n]I get all down when I'm not runnin'.
Do you like this reality?
So your leg's fine now?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: D-Do I like it? Haha, what're you talkin'[n]about?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well... I guess I did do a helluva lot of[n]growin' last year. If it weren't for all that,[n]I'd be a totally different person now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, wha...?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: My leg... Oh, you're worried about me?[n]It's totally fine, dude! No problems there[n]since that injury a while back.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And that was actually Kamoshida's[n]fault, so— Wait... What?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Ain't something wrong here?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How do we know each other, anyhow?[n]First we met in front of the station by[n]school, then...
Keep thinking, man...
I'll be waiting for you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh... Sure.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's now or never...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Here goes! Aaaaaaah!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Whoa! The hell was that...?

entries.speaker: Nakaoka
entries.en: You okay, Sakamoto?

entries.speaker: Takeishi
entries.en: Yeah, what happened to you guys[n]at the station?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uhh, nothin'!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sorry, I gotta get back to practice![n]See ya!
...It seems all I can[n]do now is wait.
I guess I should head home...
